B.S. in Computer Science student at Industrial University of Ho Chi Minh City (IUH, 2024 – 2029 expected). Open to remote contract work (~20–30 hours/week, async, written updates, UTC+7).

## Featured Security & Edge Projects
- [supabase-rls-check](https://github.com/Tthanh2k6/supabase-rls-check) (MIT, Python, SQL, MCP): Python CLI + MCP server mode running read-only Postgres catalog metadata queries to flag 8 misconfiguration types (RLS turned off, `true` policies, `anon` policies on sensitive tables, `SECURITY DEFINER` functions callable with the `anon` key, definer functions missing `search_path`, views bypassing RLS, public Storage buckets, extensions in `public` schema), plus opt-in `GET`/`HEAD`-only probe behind a consent flag and frontend `service_role` JWT leak check. CI verified on PostgreSQL 15 with seeded issues (all found, zero false positives), 52 tests; outputs HTML/MD reports + `ROLLBACK`-wrapped `fix.sql`. Fixed-scope review on Contra: https://contra.com/s/sFUXWqOZ-supabase-security-check-for-lovable-bolt-and-v0-apps
- Race-safe salon booking (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Stripe — demo build, no public live link yet): 5 simultaneous booking requests for the same technician & slot result in 1 accepted and 4 rejected; overlap checks across mixed service lengths; Stripe Checkout deposits with webhook signatures verified in Web Crypto; per-technician iCal feeds; password-protected admin page; English/Vietnamese UI; 11 tests. Setup package on Contra: https://contra.com/s/rM2mMN2k-nail-salon-booking-page-with-deposits-no-monthly-fee

## Apify Actors (each README lists its limits)
- [B2B Website Email, Phone, Social Links & Tech Stack Scraper](https://apify.com/thanh81646/apify-b2b-lead-and-contact-enricher): fetches a company homepage and up to two contact/about pages without a browser; returns emails as found on the page (not verified), phone-like strings, social links, JSON-LD types and a tech-stack guess.
- [Shopify & WooCommerce Product Price, Stock & JSON-LD Monitor](https://apify.com/thanh81646/apify-ecommerce-price-and-stock-monitor): reads product name, price, currency, availability and SKU from JSON-LD or common HTML product cards. First offer only, no per-variant data, no history between runs.
- [US Healthcare Clinic Contact, Schema & Chain Detector](https://apify.com/thanh81646/apify-us-healthcare-clinic-contact-enricher): contacts from US clinic websites, a DNS/MX check on email domains (not a mailbox check), and a keyword heuristic that guesses chain vs independent.
- [Malaysia KPKT TEDUH Property Developers & Housing Projects](https://apify.com/thanh81646/malaysia-kpkt-teduh-property-developer-scraper): flattens the public KPKT TEDUH JSON API into developer-project rows; returns two built-in sample rows if the API cannot be reached.
- [Multi-Stop Route, Geocoder & 2-Opt Distance Optimizer](https://apify.com/thanh81646/apify-multi-stop-route-and-distance-optimizer): OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocoding, nearest-neighbour + 2-opt ordering on straight-line distance times a road factor, and a Google Maps link. Addresses that cannot be geocoded get a synthetic point marked `fallback_centroid`.
